Pattern: A new agent in an open-ended domain (climate, "the landscape") must bake its anti-drift guard into its STRUCTURE, not its prose. Scope to a fixed set of concrete transmission channels (event->mechanism->repricing) where an EMPTY channel reads as a failure signal, not idle background.
Evidence: AEOLUS build (climate->economy). Directly inverts the DARWIN failure (PAT-001/002): "watch all weather" drifts; "keep these 3 channels live" cannot.
Notes: The DARWIN antidote operationalized. For any broad-domain build: define 3-5 channels, make each carry a live read, make emptiness a gap. New channels added deliberately (tier-2->core promotion), never by drift. Pair with tiered horizon (live signal layer over slow structural backdrop).

Pattern: A brand-new agent has no commit history, so ROSTER's commit-activity classifier can't place it. List ACTIVE-by-intent with an explicit "new, reconcile next pass" annotation rather than forcing a false commit count or hiding it.
Evidence: AEOLUS wired into ROSTER 6/28 with 0 commits; ROSTER methodology is 30/60d git-activity based.
Notes: Build-wiring and activity-classification are different clocks. Annotate the gap honestly; let the next activity pass reconcile. Don't fabricate a cadence number to satisfy a table.

Notes: Concrete extension of PAT-009. Never write a 'add X' next_upgrade without grep-confirming X is absent anywhere in the dir.

The rich structured record exists under a parent/archive dir (schema seed intact); the L2 climb is a PULL-FORWARD/rehab, not a build-from-scratch. Mis-reading it inflates the effort estimate and proposes reinventing an existing schema.
Evidence: CREED graded L1 'thin KB'; real KB/VX/FLOW (40KB+) live FROZEN Feb'26 under AGENTS/REGINALD/sub-agents/CREED, explicitly designated 'schema seed' by LEGACY_PULL_FORWARD_2026-06-21.md.

Before scoping an L2 'stand up workbook' build, grep parent/archive dirs for a frozen ledger to rehab. ALSO: those frozen ledgers lack the root-CLAUDE FROZEN banner (firewalled by prose pointers only) -> minor structural debt, candidate for the conformance batch.

Pattern: Grade gaps as missing-HANDLE vs missing-SUBSTANCE -- it predicts the climb cost. A richly-built agent can sit at L2 held below L3 purely by lacking the comparable HANDLES (5-pt matrix, predictions ledger, trailing BOTTOM LINE) while its substance is already L3-grade in prose/own-titled form. Handle-adds are cheap and additive; substance is real work. Prioritize handle-adds; they raise the floor fast without touching local richness.
Evidence: SHADE graded a rich L2 (4 kill-paths, 5-stage transmission map, durable-vs-live thresholds, NPORT-P reconstruction) where ~all L3 gaps were missing-handle, not missing-substance; adversarial verify called the grade 'generous, not overstating.'
Notes: Operationalizes PAT-015 (floor-not-ceiling) into a grading discipline: every CARD row carries gap_type. missing-handle -> quick win; missing-substance -> build. The L2->L3 SHADE climb is mostly handle-adds (BOTTOM LINE + 5-pt cols + light PREDICTIONS).

Pattern: A consumption/output GATE must not penalize un-instrumentable consumption — apply the anti-DARWIN principle to your OWN gates. A new standard's gate can recreate the exact false-negative the standard exists to prevent: a 'proof of consumption' L4 gate would grade RED/TERRY DOWN for informal consumption (a steelman shifts a decision; a construction gets traded) that leaves no ledger row.
Evidence: PROME review of utility-agent.md 6/28 (the standout catch) — flagged the proof-of-consumption L4 gate could recreate the ORACLE false-negative for informally-consumed output. Baked into the blueprint at activation.
Notes: FIX: qualitative proof counts (a consumer citing it; a decision that visibly moved); genuinely un-instrumentable consumption = structural-ceiling NOTE, not fix-it debt. Generalizes: every gate DAEDALUS authors must be re-checked against the same false-negative it is meant to catch. Self-application of PAT-015/PAT-001.

A routed-but-unapproved handle can be made wrong by the owner's own intervening work, so re-validate every gated batch item against live files before approval/apply.

RULE: at apply-time re-read live (PAT-009) AND re-check the item still applies; strike obsoleted items in the batch doc + flag the gate-holder (PROME). Relates [[finding_status_spine_staleness_under_appended_top]], [[finding_ledger_drift_behind_narrative]].

Pattern: A market-shaped file on a NON-market agent is NOT automatically DARWIN dead-scaffold (PAT-001). Grade the content, not the filename.
Evidence: ORACLE (utility) carries a convergence-matrix (tracks which prediction-markets are firing, live/scored 6/27) + a TRADE.md (no-sizing crowd-odds->implications routing surface) — both filled+consumed -> EQUIVALENT, NOT a DARWIN violation; the only real gap is the missing Brier scoreboard.
Notes: Refines PAT-001/PAT-015 for the utility-cohort firming. Do NOT delete repurposed surfaces as DARWIN violations, and do NOT grade them vs the market blueprint for merely existing. Check live-consumed-content before calling a non-market file dead. Apply in the WALTER/RED/TERRY/NEXUS/YEYOU pass.

Pattern: Every boot-doc tool invocation must be CWD-PROOF. A bare root-relative (`python3 scripts/x.py`) or own-dir-relative path silently depends on the incidental shell cwd and fails rc=2 from the actual own-dir launch cwd (`cd AGENTS/<NAME> && claude`). Wrap runnable boot commands as `python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/<path>"` (self-locating scripts) or `(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)[/<dir>]" && <cmd>)` (path-dependent commands); scripts self-locate data via __file__. Never leave a runnable boot line depending on incidental cwd.
Evidence: PROME packet 7/1 (inbox 2026-07-01_from-PROME): BRENT's Jul-1 boot hit rc=2 on `python3 scripts/ledger_staleness.py BRENT` from own-dir cwd + mis-read it as 'script missing repo-wide'. Fleet MIXED idioms (root-relative ledger lines vs ORACLE's own-dir fetchers) so every boot cmd depended on incidental cwd. Full-fleet grep sweep (Will-approved, 2 batches, PROME-applied 7/1 PM; initial tally inventory-incomplete twice) wrapped all runnable boot lines + added ORACLE section cwd note.
Notes: Baked into all 3 BLUEPRINTS variants 7/3 so post-AEOLUS builds inherit it. TEMPLATE half of the ask was MOOT — Will deleted AGENTS/templates/ (incl CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md) 6/30 commit 58c30516; BLUEPRINTS are now the sole standard. Conformance check ADDED to maturity_scan.py as an AGENT-LEVEL heuristic (bare runnable root-relative invocation + zero rev-parse idiom-awareness in the boot doc) — verified ZERO false-positives on the swept fleet; ORACLE's 4 bare reference-command lines are correctly suppressed by its 7/1 section cwd note (rev-parse present). Line-level strictness DEFERRED (FP-prone on intentional reference-command docs, exactly as PROME's addendum flagged). HARDENED 7/3 (PROME 2 flags): regex widened python3-only -> multi-interpreter (bash/node/npx/ruby/perl) + `./` direct-exec + multi-extension (`.py/.sh/.js/.mjs/.ts/.rb/.pl`) so a future non-Python build can't slip through (`python3 -m module` stays uncaught by design — flagging it FPs on stdlib `-m pip`/`-m venv`); the new-build-guard-NOT-regression-guard residual is now EXPLICITLY ACCEPTED in-code — the regression guard is fail-loud-at-boot rc=2 (how BRENT's surfaced), and reintroducing line-level to close it would resurrect the ORACLE FP. Re-validated: 9 detector unit cases pass + fleet 0-FP. Relates [[finding_verify_runtime_context_before_tool_broken]].
